concerns.text: FR-004 and Constitution Principle VII mandate a TEMPORAL split (2015-2020 train, 2021 val, 2022 test). Tasks T020, T028, and T029 explicitly implement a SPATIAL split (Eastern US train, Western US test) and use Linear Mixed-Effects Models (LMM) instead of the required Diebold-Mariano test. No task exists to implement the temporal split or the Diebold-Mariano test, rendering FR-004, FR-006, and SC-002 unachievable.

FR-007 requires 'continental-scale maps'. Task T032 is scoped to 'Continental US' but the Plan and T011/T012 restrict data processing to 'Lake Powell' or 'Continental US' with conflicting bounds. No task explicitly generates a map covering the full Continental US as required by FR-007, given the data scope constraints in the plan.

SC-003 requires flagging findings if variation exceeds 7 days. Task T030 implements a threshold of 'mean absolute difference > 3 days'. No task exists to implement the 7-day threshold check required by the Success Criteria.

Task T024 is marked as [X] (completed) but implements 'permutation importance test' which is part of FR-005/SC-005. However, the task description says 'Verify feature rankings are robust' but does not explicitly mention saving to the required output path or linking to the specific success criteria. While the logic exists, the traceability is weak compared to other tasks.

FR-003 requires excluding grid cells with total annual counts < 10 observations BEFORE calculating first arrival. Task T014 mentions 'Exclude grid cells with total annual counts < 10' but the logic is embedded in the 'sensitivity sweep' description. A dedicated validation task or explicit step for this exclusion prior to the sweep calculation is missing to ensure strict adherence to the 'BEFORE' constraint.
